fields.zone: The physical area or department where the record applies.
fields.role: The job title or personnel classification.
fields.authorization: Whether access or action is permitted.
fields.station: The specific equipment or location identifier.
fields.requirement: The narrative rule or operational constraint.
fields.sensor: The type of measurement being monitored.
fields.unit: The unit of measure for the sensor value.
fields.nominal: The target or ideal operating value.
fields.critical_response: The required action when a critical threshold is breached.
fields.action: The required corrective or maintenance action.
fields.depends_on: The upstream system or station this record relies upon.
fields.downstream_effect: The impact of this record's state on subsequent systems.
fields.trigger: The specific condition or event that initiates a rule.
fields.priority: The importance or criticality level of the record.
fields.max_persons: The maximum number of people allowed in the area.
fields.enforcement: The rules governing how limits are enforced.
fields.type: The classification of the anomaly or event.
fields.definition: The technical description of the anomaly type.
fields.detection_criterion: The logic used to detect the anomaly.
fields.ontology_class: The formal system classification of the event.
fields.max_ack_warning_min: Maximum allowed time to acknowledge a warning.
fields.max_ack_critical_min: Maximum allowed time to acknowledge a critical alarm.
fields.pattern: The causal sequence of events across stations.
fields.primary_fault: The root cause of the failure.
fields.secondary_effect: The resulting symptoms or side effects of the fault.
fields.resolution: The step-by-step procedure to fix the issue.
fields.condition: The narrative trigger stating when a rule applies.
fields.rule: A general operational principle or logic statement.
fields.primary_criterion: The main goal or standard for the requirement.
fields.threshold_hierarchy: The logical ordering of threshold levels.

categories.AccessAuthorization: Rules regarding who can enter or act.
categories.SensorThreshold: Limits and ranges for sensor readings.
categories.OccupancyLimit: Maximum person limits for a zone.
categories.AcknowledgmentTime: Time limits for responding to alarms.
categories.FaultResolutionProcedure: Steps to resolve a detected fault.
categories.FaultPropagationRule: How faults move through the system.
categories.VerificationProcedure: Steps to verify a state or fix.
